# f5ads_certificate (Resource)

Manages an F5 ADS certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Certificates are immutable, so any change forces replacement. name_prefix together with
# create_before_destroy lets the new certificate be created before the old one is removed.
resource "f5ads_certificate" "example" {
  name_prefix  = "example-com-"
  public_certs = filebase64("${path.module}/example.com.crt")
  private_key  = filebase64("${path.module}/example.com.key")

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# A CA-only trust bundle (type "ca_bundle") for NGINX's ssl_trusted_certificate
# or ssl_client_certificate directives. No private_key is supplied.
resource "f5ads_certificate" "client_ca" {
  name_prefix  = "client-ca-"
  public_certs = filebase64("${path.module}/client-ca-bundle.pem")

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Changing the name creates a replacement with a different unique name, so
# create_before_destroy can be used. Changing contents under the same name cannot
# be replaced this way, and destroy-before-create fails while the old certificate
# is referenced. To rotate contents, add a certificate with a new name or name_prefix,
# update references, apply, and then remove the old certificate from Terraform.
resource "f5ads_certificate" "fixed_name" {
  name         = "fixed-name-cert"
  public_certs = filebase64("${path.module}/example.com.crt")
  private_key  = filebase64("${path.module}/example.com.key")

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_certs` (String) Base64 encoded PEM certificate: either a public certificate CA bundle or leaf certificate associated with the private key.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Unique name for the certificate. Changing this value forces a new resource to be created.
- `name_prefix` (String) Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with `name`.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Base64 encoded PEM private key associated with the certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the certificate, assigned by F5 ADS.
- `not_after` (String) Not after date of the certificate.
- `not_before` (String) Not before date of the certificate.
- `status` (String) Current status of the certificate.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the certificate.
- `type` (String) Type of the certificate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Certificates can be imported using their ID, e.g.:
# public_certs and private_key are never returned by the API, so they are not populated on import.
terraform import f5ads_certificate.example cert_abc123XYZ
```
